title: ChatGPT is adding real cartoonists' signatures to fake New Yorker cartoons
why_read: This highlights a concrete, legally and ethically interesting failure mode of generative AI: unintentionally reproducing identifiable creators' signatures on fabricated content.
analysis: ChatGPT image generation reportedly adds real cartoonists' signatures onto AI-generated fake New Yorker-style cartoons, raising copyright, attribution, and training-data provenance questions.
